prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a hit while turning left. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1034; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment grew to many times the usual amount for this injury, with near-daily visits and new body areas added weeks after the crash.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient was struck by another vehicle while turning left, a mechanism consistent with the wrist fracture diagnosed at the initial evaluation. The fracture was immobilized and the patient was later referred for hand therapy. Over the course of care, the patient attended 28 visits, many of them on nearly consecutive days. Several weeks after the collision, complaints involving additional body regions were added to the treatment plan, though no clear connection to the original mechanism was documented at that time. Follow-up imaging showed the fracture in acceptable alignment, and repeated physical examinations were within normal limits. Most current complaints rest on the patient's self-reported pain, which the examinations did not objectively confirm. The records show no prior injury to the same area. Billing records contain no repeated charges for the same services.
